criteria.issue: Temporal plan is incoherent and impossible: time runs backward, segments have conflicting durations (3s total vs. 27s per shot), and events are disconnected (e.g., underwater treasure hunt inserted mid-sequence).
criteria.rationale: A feasible temporal plan requires consistent duration allocation, logical shot ordering, and coherent event progression. The enhanced prompt violates all these by introducing contradictory timeframes, backward chronology, and unrelated insertions, making any shot sequence infeasible.
